name: smrt-kitchen
description: Plan a business app with SMRT recipes in conversation, check it, and create the project on your machine. Runs locally; no separate model, API key or hosted service.

interface.shortDescription: Plan a SMRT app in chat, then create the project locally
interface.longDescription: Describe the business you run and SMRT Kitchen helps you pick a starting cookbook, switch recipes on and off, set currency, tax and theme, check the plan, and create the project in a folder you confirm. Your own ChatGPT or Codex does the reasoning; the plugin runs a local tool server and needs no extra model, API key or hosted service.
defaultPrompt: Use SMRT Kitchen to plan an app for my bakery.
Use SMRT Kitchen to start from a ready-made cookbook and tweak it.
Use SMRT Kitchen to create my planned app in a new folder.
